title: 表现良好的最长时间段
summary: 每天工作超过八小时记为劳累日，否则非劳累日；求劳累日数严格多于非劳累日数的最长连续区间。
insight: 把劳累映射为 +1，其余为 -1。前缀和 positive 时从开头已良好；否则寻找最早出现的 prefix-1，二者差为正且能给最长区间。
pitfalls: 严格多于对应区间和大于零
每个前缀值只记录最早下标
查询 prefix-1 而非任意更小值即可，因为步长为一

solutions.title: 前缀分数最早下标
solutions.idea: 用单位步长前缀和定位最远更小前缀。
steps: 扫描 i，hours[i]>8 加一否则减一
若 score>0，answer=i+1；否则若 earliest 有 score-1，更新 i-earliest[score-1]；最后 putIfAbsent(score,i)，返回答案

code.java: class Solution { public int longestWPI(int[] hours){Map<Integer,Integer> earliest=new HashMap<>();int score=0,answer=0;for(int i=0;i<hours.length;i++){score+=hours[i]>8?1:-1;if(score>0)answer=i+1;else if(earliest.containsKey(score-1))answer=Math.max(answer,i-earliest.get(score-1));earliest.putIfAbsent(score,i);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun longestWPI(hours:IntArray):Int{val earliest=mutableMapOf<Int,Int>();var score=0;var answer=0;for(i in hours.indices){score+=if(hours[i]>8)1 else -1;if(score>0)answer=i+1 else if(score-1 in earliest)answer=maxOf(answer,i-earliest[score-1]!!);earliest.putIfAbsent(score,i)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int longestWPI(vector<int>& hours){unordered_map<int,int> earliest;int score=0,answer=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)hours.size();++i){score+=hours[i]>8?1:-1;if(score>0)answer=i+1;else if(earliest.count(score-1))answer=max(answer,i-earliest[score-1]);if(!earliest.count(score))earliest[score]=i;}return answer;} };
